units.source_text: 不过，发长彦摇了摇头，厉声训斥道：“不必假惺惺！

en.t: However, Fa Changyan shook his head and sternly rebuked him: "There is no need to act so falsely!

units.source_text: 我今天我是来救被你抓走的小公主的，赶紧交出人来！

en.t: I have come today to rescue the little princess you carried off, so hand her over at once!

units.source_text: 不然，我就想杀死食蜃人一样，杀了你。”

en.t: Otherwise, just as I killed the Mirage-Eater, I will kill you too."
